objects.description:
Abstract home card. Never rendered directly: it carries the shared typography, hover
      semantics and token list that both home posters inherit. Declared here to make the inheritance
      and override rules machine-checkable rather than convention.

Home cover poster. Inherits cmp.baseCard, overrides the class, raises the hover lift and
      replaces the token array wholesale (arrays are replaced, never deep-merged).

Shell of every page: ClientRouter swaps the document, the top bar carries brand, nav,
      clock and toggles, main is the slot. PageWipe persists across navigations.

Shared navigation rendered on all three pages from a three-entry array. Because the
      same component instance renders on every route, its links carry renderScope="allPages" and the
      binding derivation expands them per page instead of pretending there is one edge.

The transition sheet: blue field, one cropped poster, catalogue slug. motion.js sweeps
      its clip-path and deals a poster from a session-local deck per navigation.

Manifesto plus featured focus area. The focus area stacks the real cover poster and the
      tracklist poster; both link to the discography page, which is why three distinct observed anchors
      point at /discography/ from this route alone.

Single-release page: cover and printed specs on the left, track matrix on the right. The
      page contains no anchors of its own; navigation is the only exit.

Issue switching is client-side only: rebuild #reader-body, update aria-pressed and
          #reader-position, rewrite ?issue= with replaceState, dispatch ivorg:layout. No navigation, no
          wipe.

fields.ariaLabel: Agree on a language — collaboration parameters

objects.description:
Printed sheet sweep. One definition family drives every navigation; the deck is shared
      across all wipe bindings so consecutive navigations never repeat the same poster.

Cover: clip-path EMPTY to FULL in 560ms expo.out; strips shift 8% to 0 in 850ms;
        copy fades in 550ms with a 0.04 offset. Reduced motion jumps to the end state.

Uncover: clip-path FULL to OUT in 780ms; strips from -8% to 0 in 600ms; hides the
        sheet when finished so the composited layer is released.

Headline decode: each character converges from an alphabet, progress eased as 1-(1-p)^4
      over 650ms; suppressed under reduced motion.
Deterministic when the rng is seeded; the runtime driver is instantiated per mount.

Entrance: reveal lines fall from 110% and cards rise with opacity, both expo.out with
      stagger, clearing props afterwards so transforms do not leak into layout.

Reader swap keeps the route: rebuild the reader subtree, update aria state and the URL
      query, announce layout. Never triggers a wipe, which is why the self binding is disabled.

objects.description: Observed and proposed links must live in their own containers and never nest.
Every declared identity, including the root documentId, is unique and prefix-consistent.
Every observed internal link with renderScope expanded is covered by at least one enabled binding.
Every directed adjacency of the three-route reading order has at least one binding.
All wipe bindings share one deck cursor name so the poster deck is dealt globally.
A binding whose fromPage equals toPage must be disabled and must not run a wipe.
At least one demo/illustrative label must remain visible on the newsletter route.
Exactly one issue is marked ssrInitial and it must be the current ISSUES[0].
Overrides may not change fields locked by the parent, nor introduce unknown fields.
